g.text: Three lengths, three questions: how far before a choice, how far into a blind corridor, how far to an exit.
Sprinklers lengthen all three, which is why this plan is read beside the sprinkler plan.
Occupant load decides how many exits; travel distance decides where they go.
Occupancy, areas and distances are fictional.
if the common path stayed short
puts the floor over 49, so two
